# iosxr_multicast_routing_vrf (Resource)

This resource can manage the Multicast Routing VRF configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxr_multicast_routing_vrf" "example" {
  ipv4                                            = true
  ipv4_accounting_per_prefix                      = true
  ipv4_accounting_per_prefix_forward_only         = true
  ipv4_bgp_auto_discovery_core_tree               = "pim"
  ipv4_bgp_auto_discovery_dynamic_ssm_translation = true
  ipv4_bgp_auto_discovery_inherit_vrf_ri_vrf      = "VRF2"
  ipv4_bgp_auto_discovery_inter_as                = true
  ipv4_bgp_auto_discovery_leaf_info_required      = true
  ipv4_bgp_auto_discovery_receiver_site           = true
  ipv4_core_tree_protocol_rsvp_te                 = true
  ipv4_core_tree_protocol_rsvp_te_group_list      = "RSVP_ACL"
  ipv4_export_rt_four_byte_as = [
    {
      four_byte_as_number = 65537
      index_number        = 2
    }
  ]
  ipv4_export_rt_ip_address = [
    {
      index_number = 3
      ip_address   = "10.1.1.1"
    }
  ]
  ipv4_export_rt_two_byte_as = [
    {
      index_number       = 1

    }
```

  - Range: `128`-`255`

- `ipv6_mdt_data_p2mp_te_access_list_name` (String) ACL for Customer VRF groups allowed to do Data MDT
- `ipv6_mdt_data_p2mp_te_attribute_set` (String) The Attribute Set template to be used with the TE tunnel request
- `ipv6_mdt_data_p2mp_te_immediate_switch` (Boolean) Switch to Data MDT immediately

  - Range: `0`-`4294967`

- `ipv6_mdt_default_ingress_replication_auto_tunnel` (Boolean) Dynamic P2P TE-Tunnel as transport
- `ipv6_mdt_default_ingress_replication_auto_tunnel_attribute_set` (String) The Attribute Set template to be used with the TE tunnel request

- `ipv6_mdt_default_mldp_p2mp` (Boolean) P2MP core-tree
- `ipv6_mdt_default_mldp_p2mp_flex_algo` (Number) Configure MLDP Flex-algo
  - Range: `128`-`255`
- `ipv6_mdt_default_mldp_p2mp_partitioned_bidir` (Boolean) Enable Exclusive Partitioned MDT for Bidir
- `ipv6_mdt_default_p2mp_te_attribute_set` (String) The Attribute Set template to be used with the TE tunnel request
- `ipv6_mdt_default_p2mp_te_static` (String) Static P2MP-TE Tunnel
- `ipv6_mdt_mldp_in_band_signaling_ipv4` (Boolean) Enable IPv4-core tree
- `ipv6_mdt_mtu` (Number) MDT mtu configuration
  - Range: `1401`-`65535`
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_ingress_replication` (Boolean) Enable partitioned ingress-replication
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_ingress_replication_auto_tunnel` (Boolean) Dynamic P2P TE-Tunnel as transport
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_ingress_replication_auto_tunnel_attribute_set` (String) The Attribute Set template to be used with the TE tunnel request
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_mldp_ipv4_flex_algo` (Number) Configure MLDP Flex-algo
  - Range: `128`-`255`

- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_mldp_ipv4_mp2mp_bidir` (Boolean) Enable Exclusive Partitioned MDT for Bidir
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_mldp_ipv4_p2mp` (Boolean) Enable mLDP P2MP core tree
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_mldp_ipv4_p2mp_bidir` (Boolean) Enable Exclusive Partitioned MDT for Bidir
- `ipv6_mdt_partitioned_p2mp_te_attribute_set` (String) The Attribute Set template to be used with the TE tunnel request
- `ipv6_mdt_source` (String) Interface used to set MDT source address
- `ipv6_mdt_static_segment_routing` (Boolean) Set MDT core as tree-sid
- `ipv6_mdt_static_segment_routing_strict_rpf` (Boolean) Enable strict RPF check
- `ipv6_multipath` (Boolean) Enable equal-cost multipath routing
- `ipv6_multipath_hash_interface_extended` (Boolean) Enable interface extensions for non-unique next-hop addrs
- `ipv6_multipath_hash_source_group` (Boolean) Enable source, group based multipath hashing
- `ipv6_multipath_hash_source_nexthop` (Boolean) Enable source with nexthop multipath hashing (better distribution)
- `ipv6_rate_per_route` (Boolean) Enable/disable per (S,G) rate calculation
- `ipv6_ssm_allow_override` (Boolean) Allow SSM ranges to be overridden by more specific ranges
- `ipv6_ssm_disable` (Boolean) Disable use of all SSM group ranges
- `ipv6_ssm_range` (String) Provide ACL that specifies non-standard SSM range
- `ipv6_static_rpf_address_ranges` (Attributes List) address range (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6_static_rpf_address_ranges))
- `ipv6_static_sr_policies` (Attributes List) SR P2MP Policy for Multicast (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6_static_sr_policies))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxr_multicast_routing_vrf.example "<vrf_name>"
```
